chapter: Chicago, the Woodside, the army and 52nd Street
title: Hampton's band, Dinah Washington and T-Bone Walker in Oakland
summary: Bands passing through Oakland included Hampton with Dinah Washington and Herbie Fields, and he nightly heard blues guitarist T-Bone Walker.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I don't remember, I don't know what it was. I was just so happy to see Billy and Joe Guy and, you know, I would like to know, I'm sure Vernon would know. But I've forgotten. But as I say all the good bands would come through. Hamp, he came through. The first time I heard Dinah Washington. She was with Hamp at this time. And they had another vocalist, Madeline Green. And very good band, and one saxophone player that I remember, I was working with him when I went into the army -- before, just before I went into the army. His name was Herbie Fields. Yeah, he was with Hamp at this time, and that's the first time I made T-Bone Band was in Oakland. I used to go to hear him every night. He fascinated me, he was just such a tremendous blues guitarist. And I had -- I used to go and hang out with them every night. We'd get a little high and you know -- I enjoyed that very much, you know.
